60037e26-f2e6-4b5b-957d-e22a77bd7f9f.title: Civic Memorial Park, Vernon BC
60037e26-f2e6-4b5b-957d-e22a77bd7f9f.hoursOnDate: hours not found (the City lists no park hours or seasonal notes)
60037e26-f2e6-4b5b-957d-e22a77bd7f9f.notes: City: 3003 37 Ave, on the old Civic Arena site, opened May 2024; matches the coordinates. Playground, walking trail, on-leash dog area, picnic area. A small city park, not a destination.

575e8e59-93a6-44ae-970d-156e70035efd.title: Centennial Outdoor Rink, Vernon BC
575e8e59-93a6-44ae-970d-156e70035efd.hoursOnDate: Closed: City releases give the season as about December 1 to late February, weather permitting
575e8e59-93a6-44ae-970d-156e70035efd.notes: Real, at the Recreation Complex. A seasonal outdoor refrigerated rink with no ice in October. Atlas already says not-on (stated-season).

1526821e-7eb8-44ce-9e68-e6d9b524440a.title: Priest Valley Arena, Vernon BC
1526821e-7eb8-44ce-9e68-e6d9b524440a.hoursOnDate: hours not found (public skate times are on the City's drop-in schedule, which was not checked for this date)
1526821e-7eb8-44ce-9e68-e6d9b524440a.notes: Real, at 3409 35 Ave. Mainly a club venue; public skating only at scheduled times, and the City says skate rentals are not available.

9591cd4f-9a5f-45aa-9a07-d83c0f22cd79.title: Polson Park, Vernon BC
9591cd4f-9a5f-45aa-9a07-d83c0f22cd79.notes: Real, at 2600 Hwy 6. An outdoor park; the indoor Okanagan Science Centre sits inside it. A claim that the spray park was removed came from a search summary and was not confirmed.

35d1b3b5-2d12-44bd-b91c-e114ff9fe7ac.title: Allan Brooks Nature Centre, Vernon BC
35d1b3b5-2d12-44bd-b91c-e114ff9fe7ac.hoursOnDate: Closed: published hours are Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM, April through October
35d1b3b5-2d12-44bd-b91c-e114ff9fe7ac.notes: Real, at 250 Allan Brooks Way. Closed on Sundays, with a season that ends in October. Atlas reads the date as unknown, so only the real-world check catches this.

eacdba44-4971-4095-8456-8409b3fde854.title: Okanagan Science Centre, Vernon BC
eacdba44-4971-4095-8456-8409b3fde854.hoursOnDate: Tuesday to Sunday 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, closed Mondays
eacdba44-4971-4095-8456-8409b3fde854.notes: Real, at 2704 Hwy 6 in Polson Park. Open on Sunday afternoon. Atlas holds it twice (a Place and an Organization).

1e045341-01f4-4640-871e-068455db290e.title: 19th Avenue Tot Lot, Vernon BC
1e045341-01f4-4640-871e-068455db290e.notes: The City's parks list confirms it at 1904 19th Avenue; the coordinates were not independently confirmed. Its only amenity is a playground.

97ad4a91-625f-48ac-a461-fb4342ef451f.title: Rock Garden Climbing Centre, Vernon BC
97ad4a91-625f-48ac-a461-fb4342ef451f.hoursOnDate: hours not found (the operator's site showed no hours when fetched)
97ad4a91-625f-48ac-a461-fb4342ef451f.notes: Tourism Vernon: #105-2450 14th Ave. An indoor gym; Sunday and holiday-weekend hours are unconfirmed.

daf1b14f-2ad0-44f7-b85b-0f6833f139dc.title: Paddlewheel Park, Vernon BC
daf1b14f-2ad0-44f7-b85b-0f6833f139dc.notes: Real, at 7815 Okanagan Landing Rd. Beach, swimming, boat launch, courts and playground: outdoors and mostly summer.

018b3cbd-c1ee-41e8-b920-a7e8d57c10f5.title: Queen Elizabeth Theatre, Vancouver BC
018b3cbd-c1ee-41e8-b920-a7e8d57c10f5.hoursOnDate: No public access outside performances (the box office is not open between performances; the lobby opens one hour before a show). Songkick lists no event on Oct 11.
018b3cbd-c1ee-41e8-b920-a7e8d57c10f5.notes: Real, at 630 Hamilton St. With no show that day there is nothing a visitor can do. The event list is from an aggregator; the official calendar was not checked.

819bc3a5-1ecb-421c-9544-12207bb4b57b.title: Queen Elizabeth Park, Vancouver BC
819bc3a5-1ecb-421c-9544-12207bb4b57b.hoursOnDate: Bloedel Conservatory 10am to 5pm (Sep 2 to Oct 31), taken from the official page's search snippet because the page returned 403. Park hours not found.
819bc3a5-1ecb-421c-9544-12207bb4b57b.notes: Real. Bloedel is an indoor option inside it. About 7 km south of downtown, and Bloedel closes at 5pm.

580e8658-1e0a-468a-8932-921541f20556.title: Roedde House Museum, Vancouver BC
580e8658-1e0a-468a-8932-921541f20556.hoursOnDate: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday, 1pm to 4pm, so open Sunday afternoon
580e8658-1e0a-468a-8932-921541f20556.notes: Real, at 1415 Barclay St, West End. Open, with a narrow window.

f12498b9-b1d1-4aa0-8633-595f66f46b8e.title: Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Classical Chinese Garden, Vancouver BC
f12498b9-b1d1-4aa0-8633-595f66f46b8e.hoursOnDate: Official site: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM (a tourism site gives 10am to 4:30pm daily and conflicts)
f12498b9-b1d1-4aa0-8633-595f66f46b8e.notes: Real, at 578 Carrall St. Atlas's coordinates are about 400 m north of the garden, toward Gastown: an Atlas geography defect.

b5228b59-3353-4354-a772-cff2fc09cd3c.title: VanDusen Botanical Garden, Vancouver BC
b5228b59-3353-4354-a772-cff2fc09cd3c.notes: Real, at 5151 Oak St. Open, but in Shaughnessy, about 6 km south of downtown, so not an answer to 'downtown'.

96f1607a-c06b-4feb-8c57-126f428ba470.title: Capilano River Regional Park, North Vancouver BC
96f1607a-c06b-4feb-8c57-126f428ba470.hoursOnDate: October 6 to November 2: 7:00 am to 7:00 pm
96f1607a-c06b-4feb-8c57-126f428ba470.notes: Open. The Capilano River Hatchery, its main sheltered draw, has been closed to the public since Oct 1 for construction; some trail and bridge closures. The trails can be used in rain.

98296e04-fa09-4eee-8aad-e61cdc6c5bc7.title: Bear Creek Park, Surrey BC
98296e04-fa09-4eee-8aad-e61cdc6c5bc7.notes: Real, at 13750 88 Ave. The pool, waterpark and spray park are summer facilities, and there are temporary closures for upgrades. On a rainy day it comes down to trails and gardens.

bfceb4ca-06cf-48ee-ad37-e2b02ba788d2.title: John Hendry Park (Trout Lake), Vancouver BC
bfceb4ca-06cf-48ee-ad37-e2b02ba788d2.hoursOnDate: Dawn until dusk, from an unofficial site; no Park Board page was opened
bfceb4ca-06cf-48ee-ad37-e2b02ba788d2.notes: Real, at 3300 Victoria Dr. Playgrounds and a lake loop suit young children. Dusk is about 6:30pm in mid-October, so it is a poor evening pick.
